newsitem.title: USA: Haddon Heights, N.J., sets Feb 8 for bond vote.
newsitem.headline: Haddon Heights, N.J., sets Feb 8 for bond vote.

text.p: The Haddon Heights, N.J., Board of Education Tuesday night approved two bond referendums for Feb 8 to finance school repairs and renovations.

The vote will include a $2.336 million bond question to fund new classrooms and equipment purchases, and a $1.527 million bond question to fund renovations to two schools needed to make them comply with regulations governing access for the disabled.
